style.vernacular: Capital spread over many red-earth hills with swampy valleys: downtown 1930s-60s Indian-Ugandan Art Deco and modernist shop blocks with balconies, glass and concrete towers around Kampala Road and Nakasero, hilltop mission churches in red brick (Namirembe, Rubaga), cream-painted villas and clinics with red or rust corrugated roofs, informal market sheds, and traditional Baganda reed-and-thatch domes.
style.ornament: Baganda thatched domes and reed fences with bark-cloth screens; Art Deco balconies and curved corners on downtown shop blocks; red-brick arched mission churches; mosque domes and minarets (Uganda National Mosque has five domes and a 50 m minaret); hand-painted signage and bright telecom paint.

sources.what: built on hills (Namirembe, Lubaga, Mengo, Kibuli) with missions and royal sites; Kasubi Tombs, Independence Monument, Baha'i Temple, National Mosque, cathedrals; Owino market; tropical rainforest climate; swamps and papyrus
